people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Vashti
people.line: Queen of Persia, deposed by King Ahasuerus (Xerxes)

translations.web: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
translations.bsb: Some time later, when the anger of King Xerxes had subsided, he remembered Vashti and what she had done, and what had been decreed against her.
